primary_source: Munguia-Rosas et al. 2015 Plant Ecology: Effects of herbivores and pollinators on fruit yield and survival in a cleistogamous herb

promotion_gate: Primary full text must establish opposing functional demands on a registered shared reproductive decision and independently resolve routing; CH/CL dimorphism alone is insufficient.
notes: Full-factorial defoliation x pollination study reports differential CH/CL fruit responses. This is a routing candidate, not yet a BALANCE-positive case.

notes: Primary study states that moderate florivory shifted relative reproduction away from CH and toward selfed reproduction; exact mechanism and conflict estimand require adjudication.
